title: WriteFreely update/delete rejects owner when body.token present but article has no edit_token
description: writefreely_api.rs:108-133 (update_post) and 185-210 (delete_post). The auth logic has a redundant second token check after the main auth block. When an authenticated owner passes a body.token but the article has no edit_token (None), the flow is: (1) token_ok=false, (2) auth check passes (owner), (3) second check fires because body.token is Some, (4) article.edit_token is None so matches=false, (5) returns 401. An authenticated article owner gets rejected because of an irrelevant body.token field. Fix: remove the second token check block (lines 124-133 and 201-210) — it's redundant with the first check and creates this false rejection path.
